briefdescription.para: DEC Special Character and Line Drawing Set (VT100).

detaileddescription.para: This table maps bytes 0x60-0x7E (96-126 decimal) to Unicode box-drawing characters and symbols used by the VT100 terminal for drawing lines, corners, and special graphical elements.
Activated by ESC ( 0 (designate G0 as DEC Special Graphics) Deactivated by ESC ( B (designate G0 as US ASCII)
Mapping table index: codepoint - 0x60

Example characters:
0x60 (grave accent) -> ◆ (U+25C6) - Diamond
0x6A (j) -> ┘ (U+2518) - Lower right corner
0x6C (l) -> ┌ (U+250C) - Upper left corner
0x71 (q) -> ─ (U+2500) - Horizontal line

briefdescription.para: The 16 standard ANSI terminal colors (xterm indices 0–15).

briefdescription.para: Clears a style flag on flags for SGR attribute-off codes (21–29).

detaileddescription.para: Maps the raw SGR code to the corresponding jam::Stamp flag bit and ANDs its complement into flags. Codes not listed in the switch are silently ignored.

simplesect.para: Codes 21 and 22 both clear BOLD | DIM. Code 21 is specified as "doubly underlined" in ECMA-48 but xterm uses it as bold-off.

parameterdescription.para: Bitmask to mutate.
SGR attribute-off code (21–29).
